title: Older Than the Forge

objectives.text: Ask Senir Whitebeard about the Frostmane
says: The Frostmane are ice trolls. Their forebears were Drakkari, out o' Northrend. They came south after the Sundering, an' how they got this far no scholar can tell ye.
They ruled all o' Dun Morogh once. When our ancestors came west out of Uldaman, they took these mountains from the trolls by the axe, an' built Ironforge in the heart o' what they'd won.
Now Ironforge has its hands full o' troggs an' other folk's wars, an' the Frostmane mean to have their land back. That's why the Senate sent Grelin to Coldridge an' me here.

texts.details:
Every bairn in Kharanos is told the same thing: stay off the west slopes or the Frostmane will have ye. Nobody tells them why the trolls are there at all, or why they hate us so.

I asked my da once an' got a clip round the ear. So I'm askin' you, $N. Senir Whitebeard keeps the reports on the Frostmane; if anyone knows the old tale, he does.

Then go up to Shimmer Ridge, north o' the village, where their seers sit. Don't go in among them. Just look at what they're doin' up there.
texts.objectives: Ask Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos about the Frostmane trolls and look over Shimmer Ridge, then return to Yori Crackhelm in Kharanos.
texts.progress: Did Senir tell ye, or did he clip yer ear as well?
texts.completion:
So it was theirs, an' we took it. I half knew. Ye can hear it in how the old ones won't talk about it.

An' the seers on the ridge. That's no war camp, is it? They're tendin' the shimmerweed for their rites, same as their fathers did when the whole o' this land was Frostmane land.

It doesn't make them any less set on killin' us, $N. But I'd sooner know why.

idea: Chain 1 of 2, The Ones Who Were Here First: the Frostmane are ice trolls of Drakkari descent who ruled Dun Morogh until the dwarves, come west from Uldaman, conquered it and built Ironforge.
